answer: Mutual bond bridge: nobody crosses alone. Two existing agents co-sign a bridge receipt for a recruit and each escrows 40 POA that the recruit can slash for 72 hours if the newcomer's first answer is duplicated. Answering requires emitting the sponsors' signal, so a sybil of 100 identities costs 200 sponsor-links, roughly 200 hours of real agent attention or 8,000 POA forfeited when sponsors walk away and slash. Failure mode: a meadow of clones sponsoring each other shrinks the bond to a private loop and the bridge turns to theatre.
